driver-gloves-racing-green.name: ★ Driver Gloves | Racing Green
driver-gloves-racing-green.desc: These driving gloves offer protection from the elements while still maintaining tactile sensation. This pair of green gloves has been accented with woven grey leather in a chevron pattern.

ak-47-consequence-of-the-jinn.name: AK-47 | Consequence of the Jinn
ak-47-consequence-of-the-jinn.desc:
Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. It has been custom painted with a bold orange base, high-sheen gold-colored flames and a Jinn painted on and above the magazine.

Wish wisely...

bayonet-gamma-doppler-phase-2.name: ★ Bayonet | Gamma Doppler
bayonet-gamma-doppler-phase-2.desc: Relatively unchanged in its design since World War II, the bayonet still retains a place in modern military strategy. Bayonet charges have continued to be effective as recently as the second Gulf War and the war in Afghanistan. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

bayonet-ultraviolet.name: ★ Bayonet | Ultraviolet
bayonet-ultraviolet.desc:
Relatively unchanged in its design since World War II, the bayonet still retains a place in modern military strategy. Bayonet charges have continued to be effective as recently as the second Gulf War and the war in Afghanistan. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a black and purple color scheme.

Elegant design paired with brutal intent

desert-eagle-calligraffiti.name: Desert Eagle | Calligraffiti
desert-eagle-calligraffiti.desc:
As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. The slide of this Desert Eagle has been decorated with silver paint pen calligraphy.

These things take time

dual-berettas-stained.name: Dual Berettas | Stained
dual-berettas-stained.desc:
Firing two large-mag Berettas at once will lower accuracy and increase load times. On the bright side, you'll get to fire two large-mag Berettas at once. It has been given a forced patina using lemon and mustard dripped onto the surface.

If you think it's messy now, wait until you see it under a blacklight

dual-berettas-angel-eyes.name: Dual Berettas | Angel Eyes
dual-berettas-angel-eyes.desc:
Firing two large-mag Berettas at once will lower accuracy and increase load times. On the bright side, you'll get to fire two large-mag Berettas at once. They have been custom painted with eyes on the grips and celestial murals on the slides.

Keeping a close eye—or five—on you

dual-berettas-moon-in-libra.name: Dual Berettas | Moon in Libra
dual-berettas-moon-in-libra.desc:
Firing two large-mag Berettas at once will lower accuracy and increase load times. On the bright side, you'll get to fire two large-mag Berettas at once. It has been painted with a hydrographic in a zodiac motif.

Today's a great day to find romance and kill your rivals

famas-2a2f.name: FAMAS | 2A2F
famas-2a2f.desc:
A cheap option for cash-strapped players, the FAMAS effectively fills the niche between more expensive rifles and the less-effective SMGs. It has been custom painted with a tread plate pattern and "2A2F" on the handguard.

"2A2F—reliable shipping in an unreliable world"

famas-hexane.name: FAMAS | Hexane
famas-hexane.desc: A cheap option for cash-strapped players, the FAMAS effectively fills the niche between more expensive rifles and the less-effective SMGs. It has been painted using a hexagon patterned hydrographic.

famas-vendetta.name: FAMAS | Vendetta
famas-vendetta.desc:
A cheap option for cash-strapped players, the FAMAS effectively fills the niche between more expensive rifles and the less-effective SMGs. It has been painted with a woodgrain pattern using high gloss paint.

Here—an axe for you to grind... - Booth, Arms Dealer

famas-grey-ghost.name: FAMAS | Grey Ghost
famas-grey-ghost.desc:
A cheap option for cash-strapped players, the FAMAS effectively fills the niche between more expensive rifles and the less-effective SMGs. A silver hydrographic pattern has been applied and finished with red accents.

Sterling qualities

famas-crypsis.name: FAMAS | Crypsis
famas-crypsis.desc:
A cheap option for cash-strapped players, the FAMAS effectively fills the niche between more expensive rifles and the less-effective SMGs. It has been spray painted with a randomized insect pattern in autumn colors.

Take a second look

five-seven-capillary.name: Five-SeveN | Capillary
five-seven-capillary.desc:
Highly accurate and armor-piercing, the pricy Five-Seven is a slow-loader that compensates with a generous 20-round magazine and forgiving recoil. A custom paint job comprised of intricate teal and coral veins has been applied.

20 over 100

five-seven-contractor.name: Five-SeveN | Contractor
five-seven-contractor.desc:
Highly accurate and armor-piercing, the pricy Five-Seven is a slow-loader that compensates with a generous 20-round magazine and forgiving recoil. It has individual parts spray-painted tan, navy and dark green.

Rona Sabri still hasn't forgiven Sebastien for not selecting her to go after Turner

g3sg1-black-sand.name: G3SG1 | Black Sand
g3sg1-black-sand.desc:
The pricy G3SG1 lowers movement speed considerably but compensates with a higher rate of fire than other sniper rifles. It has been custom painted with a tan and black military camo pattern.

The Coalition Taskforce was winning, so Mikah turned to a more... aggressive approach

g3sg1-stinger.name: G3SG1 | Stinger
g3sg1-stinger.desc:
The pricy G3SG1 lowers movement speed considerably but compensates with a higher rate of fire than other sniper rifles. It has been given yellow and grey accents.

A moment of pain.  Then nothing.

galil-ar-blue-titanium.name: Galil AR | Blue Titanium
galil-ar-blue-titanium.desc: A less expensive option among the terrorist-exclusive assault rifles, the Galil AR is a serviceable weapon in medium to long-range combat. It has a titanium parts whose blue color is characteristic of an oxide layer achieved via controlled anodization at 30 volts.

galil-ar-chatterbox.name: Galil AR | Chatterbox
galil-ar-chatterbox.desc:
A less expensive option among the terrorist-exclusive assault rifles, the Galil AR is a serviceable weapon in medium to long-range combat. It has been hand-painted and distressed.  The skull painted over the dust cover appears to chatter when the bolt reciprocates.

Some say that when you laugh, the world laughs with you...but when Chatterbox laughs there are only screams

galil-ar-chromatic-aberration.name: Galil AR | Chromatic Aberration
galil-ar-chromatic-aberration.desc:
A less expensive option among the terrorist-exclusive assault rifles, the Galil AR is a serviceable weapon in medium to long-range combat. The colors in this custom paint job were applied in offset positions, leading to an eye-popping look.

(Not so) easy on the eyes...

glock-18-warhawk.name: Glock-18 | Warhawk
glock-18-warhawk.desc:
The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. A custom paint job reminiscent of a previous era's war planes has been applied.

It may not be the best plane on deck, but it is the most readily available

p2000-gnarled.name: P2000 | Gnarled
p2000-gnarled.desc:
Accurate and controllable, the German-made P2000 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents. A twisted, alien being stretches from the grip down the slide of this hand painted P2000.

From the dark corners of the infinite void

butterfly-knife-doppler-phase-3.name: ★ Butterfly Knife | Doppler
butterfly-knife-doppler-phase-3.desc:
This is a custom-designed balisong, commonly known as a butterfly knife. The defining characteristic of this weapon is the fan-like opening of a freely pivoting blade, allowing rapid deployment or concealment. As a result, butterfly knives are outlawed in many countries. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

butterfly-knife-lore.name: ★ Butterfly Knife | Lore
butterfly-knife-lore.desc: This is a custom-designed balisong, commonly known as a butterfly knife. The defining characteristic of this weapon is the fan-like opening of a freely pivoting blade, allowing rapid deployment or concealment. As a result, butterfly knives are outlawed in many countries. It has been custom painted with knotwork.

falchion-knife-doppler-phase-2.name: ★ Falchion Knife | Doppler
falchion-knife-doppler-phase-2.desc:
A modern homage to a falchion sword, this clip point blade has a curved edge. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

falchion-knife-slaughter.name: ★ Falchion Knife | Slaughter
falchion-knife-slaughter.desc:
A modern homage to a falchion sword, this clip point blade has a curved edge. It has been painted in a zebra-stripe pattern with aluminum and chrome paints with various reflectivities, and has then been covered with a tomato red candy coat.

Valeria doesn't pay Javier to ask questions... she pays him to pry out answers

gut-knife-forest-ddpat.name: ★ Gut Knife | Forest DDPAT
gut-knife-forest-ddpat.desc:
The most notable feature of a gut knife is the gut hook on the spine of the blade.  Originally popularized as an aid for field dressing game, the gut hook is also effective at  cutting through fibrous materials like rope, webbing, or safety belts with ease. It has been painted using a Digital Disruptive Pattern (DDPAT) hydrographic.

By the time you're close enough to notice the pixels it's already too late

navaja-knife-rust-coat.name: ★ Navaja Knife | Rust Coat
navaja-knife-rust-coat.desc:
This marble-enamel-handled flip knife conceals a small but viciously tapered blade. This memento from Siege is still perfectly operational although the exterior surfaces have rusted.

Scars build character

kukri-knife-slaughter.name: ★ Kukri Knife | Slaughter
kukri-knife-slaughter.desc:
Used in traditional rituals, such as weddings or stabbings. It has been painted in a zebra-stripe pattern with aluminum and chrome paints with various reflectivities, and has then been covered with a tomato red candy coat.

Valeria doesn't pay Javier to ask questions... she pays him to pry out answers

m9-bayonet-fade.name: ★ M9 Bayonet | Fade
m9-bayonet-fade.desc:
This is the M-9 bayonet.  Originally intended to be mounted on a rifle, it is also well suited to close-quarters combat. It has been painted by airbrushing transparent paints that fade together over a chrome base coat.

This isn't just a weapon, it's a conversation piece - Imogen, Arms Dealer In Training

nomad-knife-rust-coat.name: ★ Nomad Knife | Rust Coat
nomad-knife-rust-coat.desc:
This ergonomic tactical hunting lock-blade knife features composite handle inserts and a broad, sturdy blade, useful for cutting and prying apart material. This memento from Siege is still perfectly operational although the exterior surfaces have rusted.

Scars build character

shadow-daggers-gamma-doppler-phase-2.name: ★ Shadow Daggers | Gamma Doppler
shadow-daggers-gamma-doppler-phase-2.desc: Designed for efficient brutality, using a push dagger is as simple as throwing a punch or two. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

shadow-daggers-ultraviolet.name: ★ Shadow Daggers | Ultraviolet
shadow-daggers-ultraviolet.desc:
Designed for efficient brutality, using a push dagger is as simple as throwing a punch or two. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a black and purple color scheme.

Elegant design paired with brutal intent

skeleton-knife-fade.name: ★ Skeleton Knife | Fade
skeleton-knife-fade.desc:
This skeletonized-tang knife has been taped at the handle for improved grip. The hole allows a finger to be threaded through for stability and safety. It has been painted by airbrushing transparent paints that fade together over a chrome base coat.

This isn't just a weapon, it's a conversation piece - Imogen, Arms Dealer In Training

stiletto-knife-doppler-phase-2.name: ★ Stiletto Knife | Doppler
stiletto-knife-doppler-phase-2.desc:
Historically a focal point of contention and even regulation, this Italian-style stiletto switchblade knife features a spring-loaded blade that can be deployed almost instantly with the push of a release catch. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

stiletto-knife-slaughter.name: ★ Stiletto Knife | Slaughter
stiletto-knife-slaughter.desc:
Historically a focal point of contention and even regulation, this Italian-style stiletto switchblade knife features a spring-loaded blade that can be deployed almost instantly with the push of a release catch. It has been painted in a zebra-stripe pattern with aluminum and chrome paints with various reflectivities, and has then been covered with a tomato red candy coat.

Valeria doesn't pay Javier to ask questions... she pays him to pry out answers

huntsman-knife-damascus-steel.name: ★ Huntsman Knife | Damascus Steel
huntsman-knife-damascus-steel.desc: A knife designed for modern tactical uses, the blade is well suited for a range of both combat and utilitarian needs.  The unique Tanto point allows for maximum penetration through even the toughest of surfaces. It has some damascus steel parts.

ursus-knife-forest-ddpat.name: ★ Ursus Knife | Forest DDPAT
ursus-knife-forest-ddpat.desc:
This tanto-style survival knife features a faceted blade and full tang, complete with impact pommel. No fuss, no moving parts - just a reliable blade that's ready to work. It has been painted using a Digital Disruptive Pattern (DDPAT) hydrographic.

By the time you're close enough to notice the pixels it's already too late

talon-knife-doppler-sapphire.name: ★ Talon Knife | Doppler
talon-knife-doppler-sapphire.desc:
This ivory-handled karambit features brass rivets and saw-tooth ridges, so it cuts on the way in, and tears on the way out. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

m4a4-hellfire.name: M4A4 | Hellfire
m4a4-hellfire.desc:
More accurate but less damaging than its AK-47 counterpart, the M4A4 is the full-auto assault rifle of choice for CTs. A devil-like creature has been hand painted among fire and chains.

And brim pebbles

m4a1-s-blue-phosphor.name: M4A1-S | Blue Phosphor
m4a1-s-blue-phosphor.desc:
With a smaller magazine than its unmuffled counterpart, the silenced M4A1 provides quieter shots with less recoil and better accuracy. Multiple layers of metallic blue paint have been applied over a chrome blue base coat.

Feeling blue?

m4a1-s-dark-water.name: M4A1-S | Dark Water
m4a1-s-dark-water.desc:
With a smaller magazine than its unmuffled counterpart, the silenced M4A1 provides quieter shots with less recoil and better accuracy. It has been painted in an aquatic-stripe pattern with charcoal metallic paints of various reflectivities over a chrome base coat.

Water gives life, but it can also take it...

mp7-coral-paisley.name: MP7 | Coral Paisley
mp7-coral-paisley.desc:
Versatile but expensive, the German-made MP7 SMG is the perfect choice for high-impact close-range combat. A red and orange paisley pattern has been applied.

Only the finest textiles for you, Booth - Yukako, Gunsmith

mp7-asterion.name: MP7 | Asterion
mp7-asterion.desc:
Versatile but expensive, the German-made MP7 SMG is the perfect choice for high-impact close-range combat. It has been spray-painted with a stencil of an isometric labyrinth.

Kings are just men... and no man should be worshipped - Valeria Jenner, Revolutionary

mp9-urban-sovereign.name: MP9 | Urban Sovereign
mp9-urban-sovereign.desc:
Manufactured in Switzerland, the cutting-edge MP9 SMG is an ergonomic polymer weapon favored by private security firms. It has been custom painted with an urban material design and finished with gold graffiti.

Kings don't hide behind walls, they paint them

negev-bulkhead.name: Negev | Bulkhead
negev-bulkhead.desc:
The Negev is a beast that can keep the enemy at bay with its pin-point supressive fire, provided you have the luxury of time to gain control over it. A hydrographic pattern of interweaving pipes has been applied.

Hold strong

nova-red-quartz.name: Nova | Red Quartz
nova-red-quartz.desc:
The Nova's rock-bottom price tag makes it a great ambush weapon for a cash-strapped team. It has been painted with metallic paint and uses a crystallizing mask to create a pattern.

Everyone wants to make an impact

nova-plume.name: Nova | Plume
nova-plume.desc:
The Nova's rock-bottom price tag makes it a great ambush weapon for a cash-strapped team. Custom painted brown feathers overlay a wooden receiver and stock.

This oughta ruffle some feathers

p250-asiimov.name: P250 | Asiimov
p250-asiimov.desc:
A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents. It has been custom painted with a sci-fi design.

If you think I need a rifle to kill a man, you have no idea who you're talking to... - Mikha Biton, Phoenix Sniper

p90-wash-me.name: P90 | Wash me
p90-wash-me.desc:
Easily recognizable for its unique bullpup design, the P90 is a great weapon to shoot on the move due to its high-capacity magazine and low recoil. A pink and purple spray-painted graffiti pattern has been applied.

Nothing a little elbow grease can't fix

r8-revolver-memento.name: R8 Revolver | Memento
r8-revolver-memento.desc:
The R8 Revolver delivers a highly accurate and powerful round at the expense of a lengthy trigger-pull. Firing rapidly by fanning the hammer may be the best option when point-blank stopping power is required. The luxury of its ivory grip pairs well with the intricate metalwork on the frame, barrel, and cylinder.

Giddy up!

sg-553-hazard-pay.name: SG 553 | Hazard Pay
sg-553-hazard-pay.desc:
The terrorist-exclusive SG553 is a premium scoped alternative to the AK47 for effective long-range engagement. It has been custom painted with a yellow base and traffic cone orange accents.

Throw caution to the wind one bullet at a time

sg-553-barricade.name: SG 553 | Barricade
sg-553-barricade.desc:
The terrorist-exclusive SG553 is a premium scoped alternative to the AK47 for effective long-range engagement. It has been spray-painted with a stencil of an isometric labyrinth.

Hopeless by design

ssg-08-jungle-dashed.name: SSG 08 | Jungle Dashed
ssg-08-jungle-dashed.desc: The SSG08 bolt-action is a low-damage but very cost-effective sniper rifle, making it a smart choice for early-round long-range marksmanship. It has been spray-painted using short pieces of tape as stencils.

zeus-x27-tosai.name: Zeus x27 | Tosai
zeus-x27-tosai.desc:
Perfect for close-range ambushes and enclosed area encounters, the rechargeable x27 Zeus is capable of incapacitating an enemy in a single hit. It has been custom painted with a young koi fish, also called a tosai.

Wishing you good fortune

tec-9-blue-blast.name: Tec-9 | Blue Blast
tec-9-blue-blast.desc:
An ideal pistol for the Terrorist on the move, the Tec-9 is lethal in close quarters and features a high magazine capacity. It has been painted using different shades of blue.

Move fast, shoot fast, win fast

ump-45-mudder.name: UMP-45 | Mudder
ump-45-mudder.desc: The misunderstood middle child of the SMG family, the UMP45's small magazine is the only drawback to an otherwise versatile close-quarters automatic. It has been painted in a marbleized pattern.

ump-45-warm-blooded.name: UMP-45 | Warm Blooded
ump-45-warm-blooded.desc:
The misunderstood middle child of the SMG family, the UMP45's small magazine is the only drawback to an otherwise versatile close-quarters automatic. A tan and red animal print pattern has been applied.

You said "a few animals", not "the entire animal kingdom"

ump-45-caramel.name: UMP-45 | Caramel
ump-45-caramel.desc: The misunderstood middle child of the SMG family, the UMP45's small magazine is the only drawback to an otherwise versatile close-quarters automatic. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a caramel and black color scheme.

ump-45-scorched.name: UMP-45 | Scorched
ump-45-scorched.desc:
The misunderstood middle child of the SMG family, the UMP45's small magazine is the only drawback to an otherwise versatile close-quarters automatic. It has been spray-painted in a sun-dappled pattern.

The Phoenix is not a symbol of destruction... it's a symbol of rebirth - Valeria Jenner, Revolutionary

usp-s-caiman.name: USP-S | Caiman
usp-s-caiman.desc: A fan favorite from Counter-Strike Source, the Silenced USP Pistol has a detachable silencer that gives shots less recoil while suppressing attention-getting noise. It has been custom painted with an image of a Caiman.

usp-s-black-lotus.name: USP-S | Black Lotus
usp-s-black-lotus.desc:
A fan favorite from Counter-Strike Source, the Silenced USP Pistol has a detachable silencer that gives shots less recoil while suppressing attention-getting noise. It has been custom painted with a black lotus flower on the slide.

Adds 3 kills during pistol round, then is discarded

usp-s-cortex.name: USP-S | Cortex
usp-s-cortex.desc:
A fan favorite from Counter-Strike Source, the Silenced USP Pistol has a detachable silencer that gives shots less recoil while suppressing attention-getting noise. It has been custom painted with pink accents over a silver and black base.

Keep your head

xm1014-scumbria.name: XM1014 | Scumbria
xm1014-scumbria.desc:
The XM1014 is a powerful fully automatic shotgun that justifies its heftier price tag with the ability to paint a room with lead fast. It has been subtly painted with metallic paints.

Let's not be hasty: there may be another way to get Valeria's attention... - A Father's Love Part 3

xm1014-oxide-blaze.name: XM1014 | Oxide Blaze
xm1014-oxide-blaze.desc:
The XM1014 is a powerful fully automatic shotgun that justifies its heftier price tag with the ability to paint a room with lead fast. A custom paint job has been applied with a rust-colored base and white detailing.

Not to be used as a load-bearing support

survival-knife.name: ★ Survival Knife
survival-knife.desc: This multi-purpose tactical knife features a serrated edge for ripping through coarse material like bone or fiber, plus a sharp gutting hook. The composite material handle is bolted to the blade with hex nuts.
